usedFor: Envoy for Visitors holds visitor invites and HubSpot holds contacts, so “Visitor Invited” can run “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Visitor Invited” in Envoy for Visitors, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An invited visitor becomes a contact matched by email, so repeat visitors update one record instead of adding copies.

watchOut: “Visitor Invited” in Envoy for Visitors is polling, so the contact appears in HubSpot after the next check.
